text:
Maya: Quick preflight for marketplace launch week. Focus areas: co-branded microsite, partner training webinar, SKU alignment, and launch day on-call rota. Can owners shout if theyre in?
Carlos: I can take microsite + tracking pixels. Need final hero image from design by Fri EOD.
Nina: Ill run the training webinar (Wed 4/13) and record it. Need SI playbook + 30-min demo.
Theo: Infra check: staging passed smoke tests but want to confirm throttling rules for marketplace traffic spike.
Priya: Press/comms: were scheduling a short announcement + partner blog. Suggest embargo window Wed 4/13 08:00 PT. Thoughts?
Ben: Partner logos and legal attributions inbound. DellEdge and CoreScale provided boilerplate. Legal said to include partner company links.
LegalBot: Legal note: co-marketing agreement clause 4.2 requires copy signoff from partner PM. Ticket PL-4389 created.
Maya: Action map: microsite (Carlos), webinar (Nina), SI playbook (Samira?) who is SI lead?
Priya: Samira is SI lead but shes OOO Thurs. Samira: I'm back Mon afternoon, will hand off draft to Theo for runbook formatting.
Carlos: Pixeling: drop UA and partner UTM params. We'll use utm_source=cloudpartner&utm_campaign=marketplace_launch.
Nina: Webinar agenda draft: 10m intro, 20m demo, 15m partner SI walkthrough, 15m Q&A. Can we get demo tenant pre-provisioned?
Theo: Yes, infra-bot can pre-provision a demo tenant. @infra-bot can you create tenant "marketplace-demo" with demo plan and rate limits 100r/s?
infra-bot: Requested: create_tenant({"name":"marketplace-demo","plan":"marketplace-starter","rate_limit":"100r/s"}) -> queued (3791234670)
Ben: I'll add partner quote placeholders in the blog doc and ping Jordan at DellEdge for final line.
Maya: On the microsite CTA: primary CTA should be "Get started" (self-serve). Secondary CTA "Contact partner sales". Keep tracking for both.
Priya: Agreed. Also, we'll need a media contact block and embargo instructions in the press doc.
Theo: Load testing plan: synthetic ramp to 10k requests/min during the 1st hour. If CPU > 70% autopause/add-nodes. Ops runbook will have escalation steps.
Maya: Can someone paste the terraform snippet for listing creation? Pablo had one earlier.
Carlos: Snippet below for marketplace listing creation (for partners/infra):
```terraform
resource "marketplace_listing" "redwood_inference" {
  name        = "redwood-inference"
  version     = "1.0.0"
  contact     = "partners@redwood.com"
  documentation_url = "https://docs.redwood.inference/marketplace"
  skus = ["marketplace-starter", "marketplace-pro"]
}
```
Nina: I'll include the webinar registration link on the microsite and a short FAQ. Can marketing own copy for the FAQ?
Priya: Marketing will own FAQ copy. I'll coordinate with Carlos for placement.
Ben: Confirmed DellEdge quote received via email; adding to doc now.
LegalBot: Reminder: partner logo usage guidelines attached to ticket PL-4389. Include alt-text and link target.
Theo: Dry run scheduled Mon 4/12 10:30 PT. Will execute smoke tests + simulated traffic + failover drill. Can all owners attend?
Maya: Ill run the rehearsal. Carlos/Nina/Priya/Bri (Ben) please try to attend.
Carlos: Confirmed.
Nina: Confirmed.
Priya: Confirmed.
Ben: Will be there for partner ops.
infra-bot: Deploy: marketplace-micro v2.0 -> staging successful (3791234785)
Maya: Last-minute blockers? If none, I'll lock the content freeze Fri 5pm and share final checklist.
Priya: No blockers from comms.
Ben: No partner ops blockers.
Theo: No infra blockers; will keep an eye during launch window.
LegalBot: Legal will post final signoff comment in the doc once partner approvals are attached.
Maya: Thanks team. I'll follow up with a short checklist and calendar invites for the dry run + webinar rehearsal. :calendar:
